existing_mechanisms.purpose: environment attestation, remote ledger validation, SHA-bound selection and isolated selected directory
post-application verification for the selected environment contract
guarded application of a validated selected directory
one-shot allowlisted read-only RPC provider contract
eleven-source registry, prohibited operations and output contract
fixture CLI and fail-closed live-provider construction boundary

future_sequence.objective: Independently verify and merge the documentation-only staging-canary plan.
required_inputs: Draft PR #92 at its reviewed head
completion_evidence: squash tree equals the verified tree
future_sequence.stop_condition: Any ref, history, scope, fingerprint, check or tree mismatch stops closeout.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: Owner-approved staging-canary preparation and credential design only; no execution authority.

future_sequence.objective: Perform an approved read-only preflight of current staging.
future_sequence.responsibility_owner: staging environment owner with independent verifier
future_sequence.stop_condition: Missing, expired or scope-mismatched preflight authority, mutation capability or secret-value access stops the preflight.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: Separate owner authorization for the exact read-only staging preflight.

future_sequence.objective: Attest the current staging project reference without reading secret values.
required_inputs: public or administrative project identity metadata
completion_evidence: signed project-identity attestation bound to the preflight
future_sequence.stop_condition: An unrecognized, ambiguous or unattested project stops all later work.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: The step 2 read-only preflight authorization; no connection-bearing execution authority.

future_sequence.objective: Resolve the unique staging retailer ID for 10 Reps without guessing or copying production identity.
completion_evidence: redacted unique name-or-slug to numeric-ID resolution receipt
future_sequence.stop_condition: A missing, duplicate, ambiguous or production-copied retailer identity stops all later work.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: The step 2 read-only preflight authorization.

future_sequence.objective: Attest the current staging migration ledger and schema prerequisites.
required_inputs: approved read-only ledger and schema inventory
future_sequence.responsibility_owner: staging database owner with independent verifier
completion_evidence: proof the target migration is absent and not partially applied
future_sequence.stop_condition: Unknown ledger, schema drift, hash mismatch or partial/unexpected application stops before selector work.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: The step 2 read-only preflight authorization.

future_sequence.objective: Name the operation owner, operator, credential issuer and exact UTC execution window.
completion_evidence: signed responsibility record with four named assignments and UTC start/end
future_sequence.stop_condition: Any missing assignment, role conflict or window over 60 minutes stops preparation.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: Owner-approved preparation only; assignments do not authorize execution.

future_sequence.objective: Approve the private evidence store and owner-approved retention controls.
completion_evidence: encryption, write-once, access-audit, deletion and read-after-write capability evidence
future_sequence.stop_condition: A missing store or any encryption, immutability, audit, retention or readback gap stops preparation.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: Owner-approved retention policy; no evidence collection or upload authority.

future_sequence.objective: Prepare and independently review an exact staging-only migration-selector change in a separate Draft PR.
required_inputs: current staging and production selector contracts
future_sequence.responsibility_owner: future implementation owner with independent verifier
completion_evidence: separate reviewed Draft PR admitting one staging migration
unchanged production exclusion and production selector tests
future_sequence.stop_condition: Any extra selected file, project mismatch, hash drift or production-selector change stops before authorization.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: Owner-approved plan preparation only; selector implementation and merge require their own review.

future_sequence.objective: Obtain exact owner authorization for one staging migration application.
completion_evidence: time-bound authorization binding project, ledger, migration, operator and window
future_sequence.stop_condition: Missing, expired, ambiguous or scope-mismatched authorization stops before application.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: A new explicit owner decision; D4 does not authorize migration application.

future_sequence.objective: Apply exactly one approved migration through the validated selected-directory path.
required_inputs: selected directory containing one SHA-bound migration
future_sequence.stop_condition: Direct SQL, Supabase push, an unselected directory, ledger drift or any additional migration stops the operation.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: The exact unexpired step 9 migration-application authorization.

future_sequence.objective: Verify the migrated function, roles, ACL, RLS, ledger and absence of broad grants.
completion_evidence: post-migration schema, role, ACL and RLS report
future_sequence.stop_condition: Any security, schema, ledger or hash mismatch stops before credential issuance.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: The step 9 window must cover read-only post-migration verification; no credential authority yet.

future_sequence.objective: Issue one staging-only credential satisfying the approved design.
required_inputs: exact credential privilege and revocation plan
completion_evidence: credential lifecycle receipt without its value
future_sequence.stop_condition: Missing separate authority or any excess privilege, membership or secret exposure stops before use and triggers revocation.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: A new explicit credential-issuance authorization; D5 approves design only.

future_sequence.objective: Prove credential validity is at most 30 minutes and bounded by the canary window.
completion_evidence: issued-at, expires-at and calculated TTL receipt
future_sequence.stop_condition: TTL over 30 minutes, window overflow or unproved expiry stops before RPC and triggers revocation.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: The exact credential-issuance authorization; credential use is still not authorized.

future_sequence.objective: Seal authorization for exactly one future allowlisted RPC attempt without invoking it.
future_sequence.stop_condition: Missing or invalid authorization, a non-allowlisted RPC or a nonzero attempt counter stops before invocation.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: A new explicit credential-use and one-RPC canary authorization.

future_sequence.objective: Prove automatic and operator retry are disabled.
future_sequence.responsibility_owner: future implementation owner with independent verifier
future_sequence.stop_condition: Any retry path, queue, scheduler or second-attempt capability stops before RPC.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: The step 14 one-attempt authorization; no retry authorization exists.

future_sequence.objective: Bind the future RPC request to the one resolved 10 Reps staging retailer.
future_sequence.responsibility_owner: named staging operator with independent verifier
completion_evidence: sealed request showing matching project, retailer ID and unique name or slug
future_sequence.stop_condition: Any project/retailer mismatch, ambiguity or scope count other than one stops before RPC.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: The step 14 one-RPC authorization bound to this exact retailer.

future_sequence.objective: Make the sole allowlisted RPC attempt and create one redacted control-state export.
future_sequence.responsibility_owner: named staging operator with independent verifier
completion_evidence: eleven-source, cap, schema, timestamp and fingerprint validation
future_sequence.stop_condition: Any pre-RPC stop condition, second call, retry, incomplete source, cap/redaction/fingerprint failure or prohibited capability ends the attempt without success.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: The unexpired exact step 14 credential-use and one-RPC authorization.

future_sequence.objective: Prove the entire canary stayed within the maximum 60-minute window.
required_inputs: timestamped audit events through the single RPC
future_sequence.responsibility_owner: RA-004 operation owner with independent verifier
completion_evidence: proof unused authority expired at window end
future_sequence.stop_condition: Window expiry or duration over 60 minutes ends authority immediately and prevents success.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: The exact time-bound canary authorization established before step 10.

future_sequence.objective: Immediately remove LOGIN and caller EXECUTE access after the call or any failure.
completion_evidence: LOGIN, EXECUTE and membership revocation receipt
future_sequence.stop_condition: Inability to revoke is a failed canary, triggers incident handling and prohibits success reporting.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: The credential lifecycle authorization must require immediate revocation.

future_sequence.objective: Independently prove credential expiry or invalidation and inability to reconnect or execute.
future_sequence.stop_condition: Any surviving access or unproved invalidation makes the canary failed and blocks closeout success.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: Read-only security verification within the closeout window; no further RPC attempt authority.

future_sequence.objective: Store the redacted evidence, audit receipts and detached fingerprints.
required_inputs: approved evidence store and retention metadata
completion_evidence: redacted evidence index and retention dates
future_sequence.stop_condition: Secret/raw leakage, missing evidence, public storage or retention mismatch prevents closeout success.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: Approved evidence storage and retention authority for this exact evidence set.

future_sequence.objective: Read back stored evidence and verify bytes, metadata and fingerprints.
required_inputs: step 21 object IDs and detached hashes
completion_evidence: readback hashes and metadata equal the sealed evidence index
future_sequence.stop_condition: Missing object, byte/hash mismatch or unreadable retention metadata prevents closeout success.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: Least-privilege read access for the independent verifier.

future_sequence.objective: Close out the staging canary without claiming production or shadow authority.
future_sequence.responsibility_owner: RA-004 operation owner with independent verifier
completion_evidence: explicit statement that success proves only the staging interface boundary
future_sequence.stop_condition: Any missing evidence, unexplained result or unrevoked access produces failed/incomplete closeout, never default success.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: Closeout authority only; DDL removal requires a separate reviewed migration and retention decision.

future_sequence.objective: Require a separate owner decision before any live feed capture or shadow run.
required_inputs: new proposal with current baseline and fingerprints
completion_evidence: separate explicit owner decision, or a recorded NOT_AUTHORIZED outcome
future_sequence.stop_condition: Absent separate approval, live capture and shadow remain NOT_AUTHORIZED with no automatic transition.
future_sequence.required_prior_authorization: None is inherited from canary success; a new exact owner authorization is mandatory.
